content.value_statement: Documentation teams need consistent chapters that are easy to navigate and teach from. This skill checks MDX chapter structure, learning flow, and approved interactive components.
actual_capabilities: Checks for YAML frontmatter fields used by Docusaurus chapters.
Reviews heading hierarchy and flags body-level H1 usage.
Evaluates whether a chapter includes an introduction, objectives, core content, interaction, and summary.
Checks for documented Quiz, Simulation, Tabs, and TabItem component usage.
Reviews tone for accessible, encouraging technical instruction.
limitations: It evaluates chapters against the rules documented in the skill only.
It does not build a Docusaurus site or validate component implementations.
It cannot confirm factual accuracy without source material.
It does not replace editorial review for audience needs or curriculum goals.

use_cases.title: Review a new lesson
use_cases.description: Check a draft MDX lesson before it is added to a Docusaurus textbook.

use_cases.title: Standardize course chapters
use_cases.description: Apply the same structure and learning-flow review across a documentation course.

use_cases.title: Improve contributor drafts
use_cases.description: Give contributors a clear checklist for frontmatter, headings, and interactive learning elements.

prompt_templates.title: Check one chapter
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Docusaurus MDX chapter using the Chapter Analyzer rules. List missing frontmatter, heading, and learning-flow requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Validate frontmatter
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this chapter frontmatter for the required id, title, sidebar_label, and description fields. Explain any missing or unclear values.

prompt_templates.title: Improve learning flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this MDX chapter for introduction, learning objectives, core content, interactive elements, and summary. Recommend specific improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a chapter set
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Docusaurus MDX chapters against the Chapter Analyzer rules. Produce a prioritized per-file report for structure, pedagogy, component usage, and tone.

output_examples.input: Review a chapter that starts with an H1 heading and has no summary.
output: Remove the body-level H1 because the Docusaurus title provides it.
Add a final summary that recaps the chapter points.
Keep the first content heading at H2.

output_examples.input: Check a chapter with valid frontmatter and a Quiz component.
output: Frontmatter includes the required chapter fields.
The Quiz component supports an interactive knowledge check.
Review the chapter for objectives and a closing summary.

best_practices: Provide the complete MDX chapter, including frontmatter, for an accurate review.
Use findings as an editorial checklist and verify recommendations in the rendered site.
Apply the same rules consistently across related chapters.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the review as a substitute for building the Docusaurus site.
Do not assume component examples prove that components are installed or functional.
Do not omit the target audience when requesting tone or pedagogy feedback.

faq.question: What files does this skill review?
faq.answer: It is designed for Docusaurus chapter files written as MDX or Markdown.

faq.question: Does it require a running Docusaurus site?
faq.answer: No. It reviews chapter content and documented conventions.

faq.question: Which frontmatter fields are checked?
faq.answer: The documented rules require id, title, sidebar_label, and description.

faq.question: Can it check heading structure?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks that content starts with H2 and avoids body-level H1 headings.

faq.question: Does it validate custom components?
faq.answer: It checks their documented usage in content, not their runtime implementation.

faq.question: Can it review multiple chapters?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide several chapters and request a per-file, prioritized review.
